title: Distributed logistics · concept overview
subtitle: A network of support and recovery
description: A teaching example motivated by the report’s emphasis on distributed sustainment. Named study sites and reusable actors replace fixed icon positions.

citations.locator: PDF pages 11–15; logistics risk reduction and recommendations

assumptions: All geography, timings, paths and actor counts are editorial illustration, not taken from the source.
Timeline seconds control the presentation only; they do not represent flight time, speed, range or readiness.
Lines indicate conceptual relationships, not verified interfaces or actual connectivity.
No engagement outcomes, targeting, tactics optimization or capability predictions are computed.

phases.title: Stage
phases.narrative: Introduce a generic support actor and two distributed CCA groups.

phases.title: Support
phases.narrative: Illustrate a replenishment relationship without quantifying cargo, sortie rates or risk.

phases.title: Return
phases.narrative: Show a reusable return path. Timing is for animation only.
